lessons.title: 3. Filtering Records with WHERE
lessons.description: Filter rows using WHERE, comparison operators, IN, BETWEEN, and LIKE. Query products with price greater than 100.

exercises.question: Match each SQL clause to the job it does in a query.

pairs.right: keeps only the rows that pass a test
matches a text pattern with % and _
matches any value from a listed set

correct_answer.WHERE: keeps only the rows that pass a test
correct_answer.LIKE: matches a text pattern with % and _
correct_answer.IN: matches any value from a listed set

exercises.explanation: All four filter rows; they differ in *how* a row is matched — a test, a pattern, a set, or a range.
